title: Signal generator (DDS)
summary: A function generator: sine, triangle, sawtooth and square from 0.02 Hz to several MHz in 0.023 Hz steps, amplitude, offset, duty and frequency sweeps, on four kinds of outputs.
wiring: 1 kohm resistor, then 10 nF to GND: the analog signal is at the capacitor
best for audio and low frequencies (up to about 20 kHz)
scope trigger, or a clock input
a clean square wave at the set frequency
R-2R ladder (bit 0 on J5 pin 5 ... bit 7 on J8 pin 15)
parts: resistors and capacitors for the filters
R-2R network (10 k / 20 k) for the parallel output
a scope to see the waves
tested: the self-test passed 10 of 10 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
